findings.trigger_selection: Server/alive/enemy/sight, abs heightdelta<=3 and configured horizontal range. Cast freezes horizontal velocity/navigation and fixed facing; server advances once per game tick even noAI. AI checks close roar first when squared distance<16, then fire, then stomp; actual cooldown/range gates still apply. Body priority death >451fire/452stomp/453roar >hurtTime >moving walk >idle.
findings.fire_policy: 451=24windup+60active+44recovery=128ticks, hits24/34/44/54/64/74. Whole body always faces cast direction. Independent head yaw reaches-45 at24,+45at83 and holds through84; server sweep clamps -45+(age-24)*90/59 identically. Jaw reaches25deg at24, holds84 and resets100. Bellows contract2units at24 and return26; paired mane gears counterrotate720deg by24 and2520by84. Body remains planted; no chasing target with head after cast start.
findings.fire_interface: fireMuzzle uses fixed head pivot forward.75 plus swept outlet1.25 and height1.4375, flame length collider-ray clips up to8m. One visible flame created24 if effect cap allows, follows same head direction untilage84; actor damage is six explicit strip pulses, not continuous contact from mesh. Thus last visible portion74..83 is not six new hits. Effect root length scaling is read-only interface, no effect model/texture work. Exact current refined mouth/outlet alignment remains native/geometry acceptance gap.
findings.stomp_policy: 452=10+20+32=62ticks, impacts10/14/18/22/26. Left front paw endpoint lifts6units by9, drops by10; current upper/shin/paw channels share densified analytic endpoint control. Ground origin derived from same cast-facing offset and five points .5/1.5/2.5/3.5/4.5 beyond origin. Invalid floor/blocked ray sets persisted crackStopped and stops later crack creation, not the body attack clock. Existing live cracks may outlast62tick body clip; cancellation/death clears all. No new floor edits or gameplay mechanics authored.
findings.roar_policy: 453=14+1+45=60ticks; head pitches-25 and jaw30 at14, holds24, recovers40; gear braces+/-22 at14..24. Server at14 uses radius4 LOS-gated knockback and shield stop/cooldown60. Native resistance/terrain determine displacement; do not claim fixed6m. Root body not translated by authored roar, no physics-free force illusion accepted.
findings.four_foot_support: Four two-link upper/shin chains descend from hollow_furnace, but each paw is independent root child; bronze ball child follows paw. Generator walk2.4sec assigns quarter-cycle phase offset; each paw swings/lifts only first quarter, then stays planted for remaining three quarters in endpoint space. Authored balls rotate360 eachcycle with local extent correction; this is a rolling bronze support design, not tiger skeletal gait copied. Actual speed vsworld displacement/terrain contact and final refiner geometry clearance not accepted from source alone.
findings.death_policy: 90tick death, no vanilla whole-body roll. Furnace starts sink/compress at8, reachesY-18/Yscale.45at24 and holds; core grows1.2at8 then0at16. Dead texture switches at16. Head pitches35at24, jaw35by10. Paw/ball root chains stay separate while upper limbs remain furnace children; limb and head position corrections are explicit, intentional broken-collapse geometry, not a successful joined live IK pose. Source compensation computed before v33/v34/v35 body refiners; no claim it remains grounded against actual terrain.
findings.interrupt_recovery: Accepted actual healthloss>=10 while WINDUP stops35, clears effects/nav/horizontal velocity and syncs skill0. No custom ACTIVE interruption by ordinary hit in this actor. Timegap>1/reversal during active action cancels and clears effects. Skill START change resets controller; current hurtTime drives short hurt then idle/walk, no separate stun body clip. Native restoration of head/jaw/gear pose on clip switch remains to verify.
findings.reload: Saves EliteAttack, home/site, LastCombatTick, DeathStart, LootDropped, CrackStopped. Invalid loaded attack clears owned effects; death load clears skill and restores death clock. Loaded active action with later combat timegap cancels. Effect has owner/epoch/born/lastTick/pulse persistence; flame additionally requires matching skill451/current epoch andage24..83. Cracks bounded60ticks but not required to remain in STOMP. No native restart/reconnect acceptance or arbitrary persistence reset.

observations.trigger: AIMelee starts when live target exists; dist<12 +NO_ANIMATION+onGround+cooldown0+notHolding selects20tick leap and sets70attempt cooldown. Otherwise cooldown>0 or water plus close<4+targetWidth and NO_ANIMATION chooses either15tick paw.
observations.model_timing: Paw variants each5tick preparation +3tick body/forelimb drive +2tick follow-through +5reset. Actor damage condition is animationTick8; matches end of second stage. Head/tail/body/hindlegs coordinate: torso lifts/leans, hindlegs counterrotate, striking forelimb swings; not isolated paw rotation. Left/right are mirrored variants, one policy credit candidate only.
observations.leap: Model5prepare+5extend+5hold+5reset. Entity stops navigation and faces target during leap, applies launch velocity on ground at ticks5..10, attempts close contact when tick>=15, then running/stealth off and holding on. No explicit once-hit latch in selected leap branch; do not claim exactly one damage attempt independent of native invulnerability.
observations.continuous_body: setupAnim resets default pose then applies keyed animation and locomotion/pose layers; running has torso/head counter-bob, slow walk has opposed torso/head flap. Sit/sleep/hold blend progress interpolated from actor previous/current values; sleep suppresses faceTarget, hold spreads forelimbs. These functions show complete-body force/attention cues, not reusable numerical assets.
observations.interrupt_and_reload_limit: AIMelee.stop clears running/stealth/holding, not explicitly current animation; selected hurt override removes attacker blessing but does not replace animation. Tick ends with Citadel AnimationHandler update. Save/load overrides persist sitting/sleeping/white, not these animation/holding fields. Inherited death, packet/reset and Citadel internals not read here; no full framework or restart guarantee.
